title: Associate Teacher
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Understand and apply developmental theories from conception through adolescence.
Design a play based curriculum which supports children using developmental, inclusive and anti-bias principles.

Identify and analyze quality early childhood practices including professionalism, self-reflection, play-based holistic learning, multiculturalism, and relationship building to ascertain their impact on children’s development.
Demonstrate the ability to access community resources which support and empower children and families.
